description: Bifolio. The main text is a very detailed list of the forbidden sexual relations (ʿarayot). In the margin at the bottom of recto, there is an informal note addressed to Mūsā requesting him to "come speak with me in the house, quickly, quickly" (אלשיך אלאגל מוסי ינעם יכלמני פי אלבית סרעה סרעה ושלום). The margins on verso contain various jottings in Arabic and Greek/Coptic numerals.
